//: Type-check project for `next build`, selected via `typescript.tsconfigPath`.
Next.js 16.3 changed the default type checker to the project-local `tsc`
CLI, which checks the complete project selected by the tsconfig -- test
files included. Next 16.0's compiler-API checker narrowed that to app code,
so pointing the build at this file preserves the behaviour we already had.
This is scoping, not silencing: `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` still uses the
root tsconfig.json and still reports every error in the test suites.
